recognize_zh: 此視野只見三顆正常分葉的嗜中性球與散在的單顆血小板，嗜中性球周圍並沒有血小板環繞，看不到血小板衛星現象；可能是作為對照的非 EDTA（如檸檬酸鈉）抗凝檢體抹片，與標題所述現象不符。
features: Three segmented neutrophils with normal nuclear lobation and cytoplasm
Platelets present as scattered single forms and occasional doublets, adequate in number
No platelets adherent to or rosetting around neutrophils
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without schistocytes or significant poikilocytosis
No large platelet clumps identified in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells, three morphologically normal segmented neutrophils and adequate, evenly dispersed platelets, mostly single with occasional doublets. Notably, no platelets are adherent to the neutrophils and no platelet clumps are seen, so platelet satellitism is not demonstrated in this field. The image may represent a comparison smear from a non-EDTA (e.g., citrate) sample in which satellitism resolves, or a field away from the phenomenon. As shown, the image does not demonstrate platelet satellitism and is discordant with the title; it shows a normal peripheral smear with adequate platelets.

ddx.vs: Satellitism would show platelets rosetting around neutrophils with few free platelets, which is absent here.
Clumping would show aggregates of platelets, especially at the feathered edge, rather than evenly dispersed single platelets.
